summary: Swvl Holdings Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing private placement financings with two purchasers. On August 24, 2026, it entered securities purchase agreements with Coefficient SWVL Holdings, LLC and HITE Hedge Asset Management for 8,990,317 Class A ordinary shares at $1.446 per share, raising approximately $13.0 million, closing August 27, 2026. On August 25, 2026, it entered an additional purchase agreement with Sofico Holdings Limited for 1,027,397 shares at $1.46 per share, raising approximately $1.5 million, closing August 28, 2026. Both include 180-day lock-ups; Coefficient also received registration, board nomination, and pro-rata purchase rights. These are routine capital raises, not special situations.
